title: Install Windows 11 from official media
shortDescription: Prepare official installation media and install Windows 11 on a compatible, licensed PC.
introduction: Use Microsoft’s Windows 11 download page to create installation media. Choose the correct edition for the license on this device.
requirements: A Windows 11-compatible PC; review Microsoft’s current system requirements.
A blank USB drive with at least 8 GB if creating USB media.
A backup of important files and a valid license or digital license for the edition.

steps.title: Back up and check compatibility
steps.text: Back up personal files. Review the Windows 11 system requirements and confirm that the computer supports the release you plan to install.

steps.title: Get the installer from Microsoft
steps.text: Open Microsoft’s Windows 11 download page and choose the installation assistant, media creation tool, or ISO option that fits your situation.

steps.title: Create installation media
steps.text: If using a USB drive, follow Microsoft’s media creation tool instructions. The selected USB drive will be erased.

steps.title: Install the matching edition
steps.text: Boot from the media and follow Setup. Choose the Windows edition that matches the device’s license. If Setup asks for a key and the device already has a digital license, use Microsoft’s documented skip option.

steps.title: Connect and check activation
steps.text: After Setup, connect to the internet, sign in with the Microsoft account associated with the digital license if applicable, then check Settings > System > Activation.

warnings: A clean installation or choosing the erase option can delete files. Confirm the target disk and keep a separate backup.
Do not install an edition that does not match your license.

troubleshooting.issue: The PC does not meet requirements
troubleshooting.resolution: Review Microsoft’s Windows 11 requirements and use an operating system supported by the device.

troubleshooting.issue: Windows is not activated after installation
troubleshooting.resolution: Check the installed edition, connect to the internet, then use the Activation troubleshooter or Microsoft Support.

title: Install Windows 10 from Microsoft media
shortDescription: Create official Windows 10 installation media for a device with a valid license.
introduction: Microsoft still provides Windows 10 installation media, but support ended on October 14, 2025. Consider a supported operating system before installing.
requirements: A PC supported by Windows 10.
A blank USB drive with at least 8 GB for installation media.
A backup and a valid license for the Windows edition.

steps.title: Back up and check support
steps.text: Save important files elsewhere. Review Microsoft’s current support status and confirm this installation is suitable for your situation.

steps.title: Download the media creation tool
steps.text: Open Microsoft’s Windows 10 download page and use its Media Creation Tool or ISO instructions.

steps.title: Create the installer
steps.text: Follow the tool’s prompts to create USB media. The selected USB drive will be erased.

steps.title: Install the matching edition
steps.text: Boot the target PC from the USB and follow Setup. Select the Windows edition that matches the device license.

steps.title: Check activation
steps.text: Connect to the internet after setup and check Settings > Update & Security > Activation.

warnings: Windows 10 reached end of support on October 14, 2025 and no longer receives free security updates or technical support. Use a supported system when possible.
Erasing or repartitioning a disk can permanently delete data.

troubleshooting.issue: The device has no matching license
troubleshooting.resolution: Check the device purchase records or contact the authorized seller before installing.

title: Activate Windows 10 with a valid license
shortDescription: Check Windows 10 activation and use the digital license or product key assigned to the device.
introduction: Windows 10 activation uses a digital license or a valid 25-character product key. This guide covers Microsoft’s supported Settings flow.
requirements: A valid Windows 10 digital license or product key for the installed edition.
An internet connection for online activation.
Administrator access for some troubleshooting actions.

steps.title: Open Activation settings
steps.text: Select Start > Settings > Update & Security > Activation. Read the activation status and any error message.

steps.title: Use an existing digital license
steps.text: Connect to the internet and sign in with the Microsoft account associated with the digital license. A device with an existing license for the same edition should activate automatically.

steps.title: Enter a product key if you have one
steps.text: On the Activation page, choose Change product key and enter the 25-character key supplied with your genuine purchase or device.

steps.title: Use Microsoft’s troubleshooter if needed
steps.text: If the license belongs to this device but Windows remains inactive, select Troubleshoot on the Activation page and follow the prompts.

warnings: Use only a license purchased for or supplied with the device. Do not use shared keys, activation scripts, or bypass tools.
A product key must match the installed edition and its license terms.

troubleshooting.issue: The key is rejected
troubleshooting.resolution: Check for typing errors and confirm that the key matches the installed Windows edition. Contact the seller if the key was supplied with a purchase.

troubleshooting.issue: The device was substantially repaired
troubleshooting.resolution: Sign in with the Microsoft account linked to the digital license and run the Activation troubleshooter.

references.label: Microsoft: Get help with Windows activation errors

title: Activate Windows 11
shortDescription: Activate Windows 11 through Settings with the digital license or product key assigned to your device.
introduction: Windows 11 activation is completed in Settings using a digital license or a matching 25-character product key. No third-party activation utility is needed.
requirements: A valid Windows 11 license for the installed edition.
An internet connection for online activation.
Administrator access to change activation settings.

steps.title: Check your current status
steps.text: Open Start > Settings > System > Activation and review the Activation state.

steps.title: Activate with a digital license
steps.text: Connect to the internet and sign in to the Microsoft account associated with this device’s digital license. Windows generally activates automatically when the license matches the device and edition.

steps.title: Activate with a product key
steps.text: On Settings > System > Activation, choose Change product key and enter the valid key supplied with your purchase.

steps.title: Resolve activation errors
steps.text: If the device is entitled to the installed edition, choose Troubleshoot on the Activation page and follow the official prompts.

warnings: A Home license does not activate Pro, and a license may be limited by its terms to a particular device or number of devices.

troubleshooting.issue: The license does not match this edition
troubleshooting.resolution: Install the edition associated with the license or obtain an eligible license for the current edition.

troubleshooting.issue: A hardware change interrupted activation
troubleshooting.resolution: Use the Microsoft account linked to the digital license, then run the Activation troubleshooter.

title: Activate Windows with a digital license
shortDescription: Understand automatic activation and reconnect a digital license after reinstalling or changing hardware.
introduction: A digital license activates an eligible Windows edition without entering a product key. It is associated with a device; linking it to a Microsoft account can help with reactivation after significant hardware changes.
requirements: A digital license for the device and the same Windows edition.
Internet access and, for reactivation after hardware changes, access to the linked Microsoft account.

steps.title: Confirm the licensed edition
steps.text: Open Activation settings and confirm that the installed edition matches the digital license (for example, Home or Pro).

steps.title: Connect to the internet
steps.text: Windows checks the device’s digital entitlement online. Allow time for activation to complete.

steps.title: Sign in with the linked account
steps.text: If prompted, sign in to the Microsoft account associated with the license. The Activation page reports whether it is linked.

steps.title: Reactivate after a hardware change
steps.text: Open Activation settings, select Troubleshoot, and follow the option indicating that hardware was recently changed. Select the device associated with your account when offered.

warnings: A digital license does not transfer freely between devices; follow the license terms for the specific purchase or device.

troubleshooting.issue: The digital license is not found
troubleshooting.resolution: Check that the correct Microsoft account is signed in, the edition matches, and the device is online. If it still fails, contact Microsoft Support.

title: Activate Windows with a product key
shortDescription: Enter the valid product key that came with your Windows purchase, device, or authorized license.
introduction: A Windows product key is a 25-character code. Use only a key obtained through a legitimate purchase or provided with your device or organization’s license.
requirements: A valid 25-character key for the installed Windows version and edition.
Internet access for online activation.

steps.title: Locate your key
steps.text: Check the purchase confirmation, authorized retailer account, device packaging, or Certificate of Authenticity. Microsoft account order history can show purchases made from Microsoft.

steps.title: Open the Activation page
steps.text: Windows 11: Settings > System > Activation. Windows 10: Settings > Update & Security > Activation.

steps.title: Enter the key
steps.text: Choose Change product key, enter the 25-character code, and follow the prompts.

steps.title: Confirm activation
steps.text: Return to Activation settings and confirm the activation status. Keep the purchase record in a safe place.

warnings: Never publish or send your product key to an untrusted person. Avoid keys advertised as unusually cheap or already used.

troubleshooting.issue: The key is for a different edition
troubleshooting.resolution: Install the edition that matches the key or obtain a valid license for the edition installed.

troubleshooting.issue: The key has already been used
troubleshooting.resolution: Check the license terms and contact the authorized seller or Microsoft Support with your proof of purchase.

references.label: Microsoft: Find your Windows product key

title: Check Windows activation status
shortDescription: Find the activation state and edition in Windows Settings, or use winver to inspect the Windows version.
introduction: Use the Settings Activation page to see whether Windows is activated and whether a digital license is linked to your Microsoft account.
requirements: Access to the Windows device.

steps.title: Open Activation settings
steps.text: Windows 11: Start > Settings > System > Activation. Windows 10: Start > Settings > Update & Security > Activation.

steps.title: Read the status
steps.text: Review the Activation state and any message shown. Windows may report activation with a digital license, a linked digital license, or that it is not activated.

steps.title: Check the installed version if needed
steps.text: Open Start, type winver, and open the result to see the Windows version and build.

warnings: Activation status is not a substitute for checking that the license and copy of Windows meet the applicable license terms.

troubleshooting.issue: Settings reports that Windows is not activated
troubleshooting.resolution: Check that the device is online and the edition matches the license. Use the Activation troubleshooter or Microsoft’s activation help.

title: Troubleshoot Windows activation
shortDescription: Use official Windows diagnostics to resolve edition mismatches, connectivity problems, or reactivation after a hardware change.
introduction: Start with the error shown in Activation settings. Microsoft’s troubleshooter and error-code guidance are the supported paths for resolving activation problems.
requirements: An administrator account for the troubleshooter.
Internet access for online activation.
Purchase details or the Microsoft account linked to the license, if applicable.

steps.title: Record the error and edition
steps.text: Open Activation settings and note the exact error code. Use winver if you need to check the Windows version.

steps.title: Check connectivity and date
steps.text: Confirm the device has internet access and the system date and time are correct, then retry activation.

steps.title: Run the Activation troubleshooter
steps.text: Open the Activation page and choose Troubleshoot when available. Follow the prompts; after hardware changes, choose the recent hardware change path if offered.

steps.title: Check edition and license match
steps.text: Confirm the installed edition matches the digital license or product key. Use Microsoft’s error-code article for the exact code.

steps.title: Contact the seller or Microsoft
steps.text: If a newly purchased key fails, keep proof of purchase and contact the authorized seller or Microsoft Support.

warnings: Do not run third-party activators, scripts, or commands that claim to bypass licensing. They can compromise the device and do not grant a license.

troubleshooting.issue: Troubleshooter is unavailable
troubleshooting.resolution: Microsoft notes that it is offered for eligible, unactivated devices. Follow the error-specific guidance or contact support.

troubleshooting.issue: An organization-managed device shows a volume activation message
troubleshooting.resolution: Contact the organization’s IT administrator; organizational activation is managed under its volume licensing agreement.

references.label: Microsoft: Get help with activation errors

title: Windows licensing basics
shortDescription: Understand product keys, digital licenses, edition matching, and safe license handling.
introduction: Windows activation validates a license for a device. The available activation method depends on how Windows was acquired and on the license terms.
requirements: A genuine Windows license from the device maker, Microsoft, an authorized retailer, or an eligible organization.

steps.title: Identify how Windows was acquired
steps.text: A preinstalled PC, boxed copy, authorized digital retailer, Microsoft Store purchase, and organization license may each use a different activation path.

steps.title: Match license and edition
steps.text: Check whether the license covers Home, Pro, or another edition before installing or upgrading.

steps.title: Keep license records secure
steps.text: Store proof of purchase and account details safely. Do not post product keys publicly or share them with untrusted support contacts.

steps.title: Use official activation settings
steps.text: Activate or resolve a license issue from Windows Settings or through Microsoft Support.

warnings: Activation tools or scripts cannot create a license. Avoid any service that promises free activation or bypasses Microsoft licensing.

troubleshooting.issue: Unclear whether a key is legitimate
troubleshooting.resolution: Ask the seller for proof and contact Microsoft Support. Avoid entering keys from unknown websites.

title: Install Ubuntu Desktop
shortDescription: Download the official Ubuntu image, prepare bootable media, and install or try Ubuntu.
introduction: Ubuntu’s official tutorial explains how to prepare a USB installer and install Ubuntu. You can also try it from USB before installing.
requirements: A computer that meets the current Ubuntu Desktop requirements.
A USB drive for installation media.
A backup before changing partitions or operating systems.

steps.title: Download the official image
steps.text: Get the Ubuntu Desktop ISO from Ubuntu’s download page.

steps.title: Create bootable media
steps.text: Use an image-writing utility to write the ISO to a USB drive, following Ubuntu’s current tutorial.

steps.title: Boot from the USB
steps.text: Restart the computer and choose the USB device from its boot menu. Select the option to try or install Ubuntu.

steps.title: Choose the installation type
steps.text: Carefully review the disk and partition options. Select an alongside-install option only when you understand the layout and have a backup.

steps.title: Finish setup and update
steps.text: Create your user account, finish installation, restart, and install updates through Software Updater.

warnings: Choosing Erase disk deletes data. If Windows BitLocker is enabled, review Ubuntu’s official dual-boot guidance before changing partitions.

troubleshooting.issue: USB installer does not boot
troubleshooting.resolution: Recreate the media from the official ISO and consult the computer manufacturer’s boot-menu guidance.

troubleshooting.issue: Installer cannot safely inspect a BitLocker drive
troubleshooting.resolution: Read Ubuntu’s official BitLocker and dual-boot guidance before proceeding.

title: Install software safely on Windows
shortDescription: Prefer Microsoft Store or the software publisher’s own download page and review the installer before running it.
introduction: Use a trusted source and verify that the download is intended for your operating system. Microsoft Store and publisher websites provide current installers and installation instructions.
requirements: A supported Windows computer.
Administrator access only when the installer legitimately requires it.

steps.title: Find the publisher’s official page
steps.text: Search for the vendor’s own site or the Microsoft Store listing. Avoid third-party download portals and ads that imitate vendor pages.

steps.title: Check the app and license
steps.text: Confirm the product name, publisher, supported Windows version, and whether it is free, paid, or a trial.

steps.title: Download and inspect the installer
steps.text: Save the installer from the official source. Check its digital publisher information before you run it.

steps.title: Install and keep it updated
steps.text: Follow the installer prompts, review optional components, then use the app or vendor updater to install security updates.

warnings: Do not run unexpected installers or disable security protections to force an installation.

troubleshooting.issue: Windows blocks or warns about an installer
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify that you downloaded the correct file from the publisher. If the publisher cannot be verified, do not proceed; contact the vendor.

title: Install Python from Python.org
shortDescription: Choose a supported Python release and install it from the official Python downloads site.
introduction: Python.org provides installers and release notes. Choose a stable release and installer that matches your operating system and architecture.
requirements: A supported Windows, macOS, or Linux system.
Administrator access may be needed to install for all users.

steps.title: Choose a release
steps.text: Open Python.org Downloads and select a stable release supported by your project. Read its release notes.

steps.title: Download the matching installer
steps.text: Choose the appropriate package for your operating system and processor architecture.

steps.title: Run the installer
steps.text: Follow the installer prompts. On Windows, enable the PATH option only if you want Python available from a terminal.

steps.title: Confirm installation
steps.text: Open a new terminal and check the installed version.

warnings: Avoid installing from third-party download portals. Some projects require a specific Python version, so check their requirements first.

troubleshooting.issue: The python command is not found
troubleshooting.resolution: Open a new terminal after installation and review the installer’s PATH options. Follow the official platform instructions.

steps.text: With the environment active, install only packages your project requires. Deactivate the environment when finished.

title: Get started with Cisco Packet Tracer
shortDescription: Enroll in Cisco’s free introductory learning course to access Packet Tracer and its official setup material.
introduction: Cisco Networking Academy provides an introductory self-paced course that explains how to download and use Packet Tracer. A Cisco learning account may be required.
requirements: A Cisco Networking Academy or Skills for All account as required by Cisco.
A supported Windows, Linux, or macOS computer.

steps.title: Open Cisco’s course
steps.text: Visit the official Getting Started with Cisco Packet Tracer course and sign in or enroll.

steps.title: Download the supported installer
steps.text: Use the course or Cisco Resource Hub download page and select the installer for your operating system.

steps.title: Install and sign in
steps.text: Run the installer, review Cisco’s license terms, then open Packet Tracer and sign in if requested.

steps.title: Start with the course labs
steps.text: Follow Cisco’s learning modules to create a small network and inspect how packets move between devices.

warnings: Download the installer only from Cisco’s learning resources. Cisco may require sign-in to access it.

troubleshooting.issue: Download option is not visible
troubleshooting.resolution: Sign in to the Cisco course or Resource Hub and confirm account eligibility.

references.label: Cisco: Getting Started with Packet Tracer

title: Install Oracle VirtualBox
shortDescription: Download VirtualBox for your host operating system and create a virtual machine using official media.
introduction: VirtualBox runs guest operating systems in virtual machines. Oracle’s download page lists host installers and separate extension-pack licensing information.
requirements: A supported host operating system and processor with virtualization support.
Enough memory and disk space for the host and guest.
An authorized installer image for the guest OS.

steps.title: Download VirtualBox
steps.text: Choose the installer for your host operating system from Oracle’s official downloads page.

steps.title: Install the host package
steps.text: Run the installer and review any network or device driver prompts. Restart if requested.

steps.title: Create a virtual machine
steps.text: Open VirtualBox, choose New, select the guest OS type, and assign resources appropriate for the host.

steps.title: Attach authorized installation media
steps.text: Select an ISO you obtained from the operating system publisher and start the virtual machine.

warnings: Do not allocate more CPU, memory, or storage than the host can spare. Review the separate license terms for VirtualBox Extension Pack.

troubleshooting.issue: A virtual machine does not start
troubleshooting.resolution: Check that hardware virtualization is enabled and consult Oracle’s manual for the displayed error.

title: Create a bootable USB with Rufus
shortDescription: Write a bootable ISO to USB using Rufus from its official website.
introduction: Rufus creates bootable USB drives from ISO images. Obtain both Rufus and the operating-system image from their official publishers.
requirements: A Windows PC supported by Rufus.
A USB drive with enough capacity for the image; its contents will be erased.
An official ISO image and a verified checksum or signature when provided by its publisher.

steps.title: Download Rufus
steps.text: Download Rufus from rufus.ie. Review the publisher’s release notes and choose the suitable build.

steps.title: Connect the USB drive
steps.text: Copy any files you need from the drive because creating bootable media erases its contents.

steps.title: Select the ISO
steps.text: Open Rufus, select the intended USB device, choose the official ISO, and review the partition and target-system settings.

steps.title: Write and verify
steps.text: Start the operation, confirm the erase prompt only if the selected drive is correct, and wait for Rufus to finish.

warnings: Double-check the target USB device before writing; selecting the wrong drive can erase important data.

troubleshooting.issue: The USB is not offered as a boot device
troubleshooting.resolution: Recreate the USB from the official ISO and consult the computer maker’s UEFI boot instructions.

title: Install Microsoft 365 or Office
shortDescription: Install or reinstall Office from the Microsoft account or organization that owns the license.
introduction: Microsoft’s installation flow begins by signing in with the account associated with the purchase, subscription, or organization license.
requirements: A valid Microsoft 365 subscription, Office license, or organization-provided entitlement.
Internet access and the account associated with that license.

steps.title: Sign in to the licensed account
steps.text: Open Microsoft’s Office installation support page and follow its sign-in link. Use the account associated with the purchase or work/school entitlement.

steps.title: Choose Install
steps.text: Select the installation option shown for your license and operating system.

steps.title: Run the installer
steps.text: Open the downloaded installer and follow its prompts. Keep the device connected while setup completes.

steps.title: Open an Office app
steps.text: Start Word or another Office app and sign in if prompted to confirm the license.

warnings: Avoid installers described as pre-activated or modified. Use Microsoft’s account or organization portal.

troubleshooting.issue: The install option is missing
troubleshooting.resolution: Confirm you signed in with the account that owns the entitlement. For work or school licenses, contact the organization administrator.

references.label: Microsoft: Download and install Microsoft 365 or Office

title: Install Adobe Photoshop
shortDescription: Install Photoshop from Adobe Creative Cloud and manage the subscription or trial from your Adobe account.
introduction: Adobe distributes Photoshop through Creative Cloud. Sign in to the Adobe account associated with the plan or trial, and follow Adobe’s install instructions.
requirements: An Adobe account and eligible subscription or trial.
A computer that meets Adobe’s current Photoshop system requirements.
Internet access for Creative Cloud installation and account checks.

steps.title: Review plan and trial terms
steps.text: Check the current Photoshop plan and trial conditions. Adobe states that trials may convert to a paid membership unless canceled before the trial ends.

steps.title: Install Creative Cloud
steps.text: Use Adobe’s official Download and Install help page to install the Creative Cloud desktop app.

steps.title: Install Photoshop
steps.text: Sign in to Creative Cloud, locate Photoshop, and choose Install.

steps.title: Open and update
steps.text: Launch Photoshop from Creative Cloud and install available updates there.

warnings: Read Adobe’s billing and cancellation terms before starting a trial. Do not use modified installers or unauthorized activation tools.

troubleshooting.issue: Photoshop does not appear in Creative Cloud
troubleshooting.resolution: Confirm the account has an active plan or trial and check Adobe’s download/install troubleshooting resources.
